about_the_game:
Coco is a little cat on a big adventure. Help her to uncover the mystery of the missing members of the Adventurers Guild in the charming Tambryn Valley. Along the way, you'll explore a cozy, vibrant world full of secrets, meet delightful characters, and solve thoughtful, story-driven puzzles. With a sprinkle of humor and a touch of self-awareness, Bravest Coconut invites you, the player, to also be a part of her story. It's a warm and whimsical tale of courage, connection, and finding your place in the world.

Features

  • Play through the cozy story while exploring the beautiful valley. 

  • A full cast of quirky characters with countless nonlinear dialogue choices. 

  • Solve a bunch of story-driven puzzles.

  • Discover a long list of secrets and collectibles.

  • Simple and fun combat system.

  • Hand crafted pixel art 

  • Full controller support 

  • Lots of handy accessibility options to craft a personalised playing experience

  • Catchy original soundtrack 

  • Shenanigans

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Bravest Coconut is a silly game about solving story-driven puzzles, meeting a cast of quirky characters, and exploring a world littered with secrets... and you’re a cat. Help Coco unravel the mysterious disappearance of the other members of the Adventurers Guild before it's too late!
